surveillance_system: CDC National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System (NNDSS)
kind: cumulative notifications as of each epidemiological week; not finalized annual cases, incidence, deaths, or infections

clinical.definition: Clinical case notifications; do not combine with screening-only notifications.

screening.definition: Screening case notifications; positive colonization screening is not a clinical case or necessarily infection.

caveats: Weekly counts are provisional and may increase or decrease when jurisdictions correct reports.
The national figure excludes U.S. territories and uses reporting notifications, not a final specimen-year annual tabulation.
A snapshot is a point-in-time report and is not proof of an active outbreak.
Do not subtract successive cumulative totals to infer new infections or death counts.
Not directly comparable with CDC's separate 2016–2024 finalized historical tracking data or its frozen MMWR case-level analysis.
Incomplete and variable jurisdiction reporting can affect comparisons.
No 2026 year-end estimate, individual risk score, or forecast is supplied.
